entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number to pull up your account?
Of course. It's Sarah Miller, order number 774-09B-112.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. It's just... I've **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** for a New Year's resolution, but I just **don't use it** nearly as much as I thought I would. To be honest, I could really use the money back right now.
I completely understand. Let me just take a moment to review the return eligibility for you.
Okay, thank you. I was so worried I was too late. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
Alright Sarah, thank you for waiting. I've checked our system, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. So, we can definitely get that processed for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I saw something online about a different policy and I was worried I'd have to go through the trouble of finding a **resale** marketplace for it.

No need for that at all. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David! This is a huge help. You have no idea.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Have a great rest of your day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
